items.source: The <springProperty> tag lets you expose properties from the Spring Environment for use within Logback. Doing so can be useful if you want to access values from your application.properties file in your Logback configuration. The tag works in a similar way to Logback’s standard <property> tag. However, rather than specifying a direct value, you specify the source of the property (from the Environment). If you need to store the property somewhere other than in local scope, you can use the scope attribute. If you need a fallback value (in case the property is not set in the Environment), you can use the defaultValue attribute. The following example shows how to expose properties for use within Logback:

items.source: All the supported logging systems can have the logger levels set in the Spring Environment (for example, in application.properties) by using logging.level.<logger-name>=<level> where level is one of TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, FATAL, or OFF. The root logger can be configured by using logging.level.root.
items.translation: 所有支持的日志系统都可以通过在 Spring Environment 中设置日志级别来配置（例如，在 application.properties 中），使用 logging.level.<logger-name>=<level>，其中 level 是 TRACE、DEBUG、INFO、WARN、ERROR、FATAL 或 OFF 之一。 可以通过使用 logging.level.root 来配置 root 记录器。

The <springProfile> tag can contain a profile name (for example staging) or a profile expression. A profile expression allows for more complicated profile logic to be expressed, for example production & (eu-central | eu-west). Check the Spring Framework reference guide for more details. items.source: All system properties that are loaded after the Log4j2 initialization can be obtained from the Spring Environment. For example, you could add log4j2.skipJansi=false to your application.properties file to have the ConsoleAppender use Jansi on Windows.
items.translation: 初始化 Log4j2 之后加载的所有系统属性都可以通过 Spring Environment 获取。例如，您可以在 application.properties 文件中添加 log4j2.skipJansi=false，以便在 Windows 上让 ConsoleAppender 使用 Jansi。

items.source: Log Level: ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, or TRACE.
items.translation: 日志级别：ERROR、WARN、INFO、DEBUG 或 TRACE。

items.source: By default, Spring Boot logs only to the console and does not write log files. If you want to write log files in addition to the console output, you need to set a logging.file.name or logging.file.path property (for example, in your application.properties). If both properties are set, logging.file.path is ignored and only logging.file.name is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring Boot 仅向控制台记录日志，不写入日志文件。 如果您希望在控制台输出之外写入日志文件，需要设置 logging.file.name` 或 `logging.file.path` 属性（例如在您的 `application.properties` 中）。 如果同时设置了这两个属性，则忽略 `logging.file.path`，仅使用 `logging.file.name。

items.source: In order to release logging resources when your application terminates, a shutdown hook that will trigger log system cleanup when the JVM exits is provided. This shutdown hook is registered automatically unless your application is deployed as a war file. If your application has complex context hierarchies the shutdown hook may not meet your needs. If it does not, disable the shutdown hook and investigate the options provided directly by the underlying logging system. For example, Logback offers context selectors which allow each Logger to be created in its own context. You can use the logging.register-shutdown-hook property to disable the shutdown hook. Setting it to false will disable the registration. You can set the property in your application.properties or application.yaml file:
items.translation: 为了在应用程序终止时释放日志资源，提供了一个将在 JVM 退出时触发日志系统清理的关闭钩子。 除非您的应用程序作为 war 文件部署，否则该关闭钩子会自动注册。 如果您的应用程序具有复杂的上下文层次结构，该关闭钩子可能无法满足您的需求。 如果无法满足需求，请禁用关闭钩子并调查底层日志系统提供的选项。 例如，Logback 提供上下文选择器，允许每个 Logger 在其自己的上下文中创建。 您可以使用 logging.register-shutdown-hook 属性来禁用关闭钩子。 将其设置为 false 将禁用注册。 您可以在 application.properties 或 application.yaml 文件中设置该属性：

items.source: If you want to refer to properties from your Spring Environment within your Log4j2 configuration you can use spring: prefixed lookups. Doing so can be useful if you want to access values from your application.properties file in your Log4j2 configuration.
items.translation: 如果您想在 Log4j2 配置中引用 Spring Environment 的属性，可以使用带有 spring: 前缀的lookups。这样做在 Log4j2 配置中访问application.properties文件中的值时非常有用。

items.source: Log4j2 supports a number of System Properties that can be used to configure various items. For example, the log4j2.skipJansi system property can be used to configure if the ConsoleAppender will try to use a Jansi output stream on Windows.
items.translation: Log4j2 支持多种系统属性，可用于配置各种项目。例如，log4j2.skipJansi 系统属性可用于配置 ConsoleAppender 是否尝试在 Windows 上使用 Jansi 输出流。

items.source: Spring Boot uses Commons Logging for all internal logging but leaves the underlying log implementation open. Default configurations are provided for Java Util Logging, Log4j2, and Logback. In each case, loggers are pre-configured to use console output with optional file output also available.
items.translation: Spring Boot 使用Commons Logging进行所有内部日志记录，但底层日志实现是开放的。 为Java Util Logging、Log4j2和Logback提供了默认配置。 在每种情况下，日志记录器都预配置为使用控制台输出，同时也可选地提供文件输出。

items.source: The default log configuration echoes messages to the console as they are written. By default, ERROR-level, WARN-level, and INFO-level messages are logged. You can also enable a “debug” mode by starting your application with a --debug flag.
items.translation: 默认日志配置会在写入时将消息回显到控制台。 默认情况下，会记录 ERROR` 级别、`WARN` 级别和 `INFO` 级别的消息。 您也可以通过使用 `--debug 标志启动应用程序来启用“调试”模式。

items.source: If you are using the Logback, it is possible to fine-tune log rotation settings using your application.properties or application.yaml file. For all other logging system, you will need to configure rotation settings directly yourself (for example, if you use Log4j2 then you could add a log4j2.xml or log4j2-spring.xml file).
items.translation: 如果您使用的是 Logback，可以通过您的 application.properties` 或 `application.yaml` 文件微调日志轮转设置。对于其他所有日志系统，您需要自行配置轮转设置（例如，如果您使用 Log4j2，则可以添加一个 `log4j2.xml` 或 `log4j2-spring.xml 文件）。

items.source: You can force Spring Boot to use a particular logging system by using the org.springframework.boot.logging.LoggingSystem system property. The value should be the fully qualified class name of a LoggingSystem implementation. You can also disable Spring Boot’s logging configuration entirely by using a value of none.
items.translation: 您可以通过使用 `org.springframework.boot.logging.LoggingSystem` 系统属性来强制 Spring Boot 使用特定的日志系统。该值应为 `LoggingSystem` 实现的完全限定类名。您还可以通过使用 `none` 值来完全禁用 Spring Boot 的日志配置。

items.source: If you need complete control over stack trace printing you can set logging.structured.json.stacktrace.printer to the name of a StackTracePrinter implementation. You can also set it to logging-system to force regular logging system stack trace output to be used.
items.translation: 如果您需要对堆栈跟踪打印进行完全控制，可以将 logging.structured.json.stacktrace.printer` 设置为一个 `StackTracePrinter` 实现类的名称。 您也可以将其设置为 `logging-system，以强制使用常规日志系统的堆栈跟踪输出。

items.source: Alternatively, you can enable a “trace” mode by starting your application with a --trace flag (or trace=true in your application.properties). Doing so enables trace logging for a selection of core loggers (embedded container, Hibernate schema generation, and the whole Spring portfolio).
items.translation: 或者，您可以通过使用 --trace` 标志启动应用程序（或在您的 `application.properties` 中设置 `trace=true）来启用“跟踪”模式。这样做将为部分核心记录器（嵌入式容器、Hibernate 架构生成以及整个 Spring 系列）启用跟踪日志记录。

items.source: Log files rotate when they reach 10 MB and, as with console output, ERROR-level, WARN-level, and INFO-level messages are logged by default.
items.translation: 日志文件在达到 10 MB 时会进行轮转，并且与控制台输出一样，默认记录 ERROR` 级别、`WARN` 级别和 `INFO 级别的消息。

items.source: It is also possible to set logging levels using environment variables. For example, LOGGING_LEVEL_ORG_SPRINGFRAMEWORK_WEB=DEBUG will set org.springframework.web to DEBUG.
items.translation: 也可以使用环境变量设置日志级别。例如，LOGGING_LEVEL_ORG_SPRINGFRAMEWORK_WEB=DEBUG 会将 org.springframework.web 设置为 DEBUG。

items.source: The various logging systems can be activated by including the appropriate libraries on the classpath and can be further customized by providing a suitable configuration file in the root of the classpath or in a location specified by the following Spring Environment property: logging.config.
items.translation: 各种日志系统可以通过在类路径中包含相应的库来激活，并可以通过在类路径根目录或以下 Spring Environment 属性指定的位置提供合适的配置文件来进一步自定义：logging.config。

items.source: If you want to use a placeholder in a logging property, you should use Spring Boot’s syntax and not the syntax of the underlying framework. Notably, if you use Logback, you should use : as the delimiter between a property name and its default value and not use :-.
items.translation: 如果您想在日志属性中使用占位符，应使用Spring Boot 的语法，而不是底层框架的语法。 特别是，如果您使用 Logback，应在属性名和默认值之间使用:作为分隔符，而不要使用:-。

items.source: You can add MDC and other ad-hoc content to log lines by overriding only the LOG_LEVEL_PATTERN (or logging.pattern.level with Logback). For example, if you use logging.pattern.level=user:%X{user} %5p, then the default log format contains an MDC entry for "user", if it exists, as shown in the following example.

items.source: Your StackTracePrinter implementation can also include a constructor argument that accepts a StandardStackTracePrinter if it wishes to apply further customization to the stack trace printer created from the properties.
items.translation: 您的 `StackTracePrinter` 实现还可以包含一个构造函数参数，该参数接受一个 StandardStackTracePrinter，以便对从属性创建的堆栈跟踪打印机应用进一步的自定义。

items.source: When the debug mode is enabled, a selection of core loggers (embedded container, Hibernate, and Spring Boot) are configured to output more information. Enabling the debug mode does not configure your application to log all messages with DEBUG level.
items.translation: 启用调试模式时，会配置一组核心日志记录器（嵌入式容器、Hibernate 和 Spring Boot）以输出更多信息。 启用调试模式并不会将您的应用程序配置为记录所有级别为DEBUG的消息。

items.source: If you want to disable console-based logging, you can set the logging.console.enabled property to false.
items.translation: 如果您想禁用基于控制台的日志记录，可以将 logging.console.enabled` 属性设置为 `false。

items.source: If your terminal supports ANSI, color output is used to aid readability. You can set spring.output.ansi.enabled to a supported value to override the auto-detection.
items.translation: 如果您的终端支持 ANSI，将使用彩色输出以提高可读性。您可以将 spring.output.ansi.enabled 设置为一个受支持的值，以覆盖自动检测。

items.source: Writes spring.log to the directory specified by logging.file.path. The directory can be absolute or relative to the current directory.
items.translation: 将 spring.log` 写入由 `logging.file.path 指定的目录。该目录可以是绝对路径，也可以是相对于当前目录的路径。

items.source: Writes to the location specified by logging.file.name and ignores logging.file.path. The location can be absolute or relative to the current directory.
items.translation: 写入由 logging.file.name` 指定的位置，并忽略 `logging.file.path。该位置可以是绝对路径或相对于当前目录的路径。

items.source:
By default, if you use the starters, Logback is used for logging.
Appropriate Logback routing is also included to ensure that dependent libraries that use Java Util Logging, Commons Logging, Log4J, or SLF4J all work correctly.

items.source:
Structured logging is a technique where the log output is written in a well-defined, often machine-readable format.
Spring Boot supports structured logging and has support for the following JSON formats out of the box:
items.translation: 结构化日志是一种将日志输出以定义良好、通常为机器可读的格式写入的技术。Spring Boot 支持结构化日志，并且开箱即用地支持以下 JSON 格式：

items.source:
Spring Boot attempts to pick sensible defaults for the JSON names and values output for structured logging.
Sometimes, however, you may want to make small adjustments to the JSON for your own needs.
For example, it’s possible that you might want to change some of the names to match the expectations of your log ingestion system.
You might also want to filter out certain members since you don’t find them useful.
items.translation: Spring Boot 会尝试为结构化日志输出的 JSON 名称和值选择合理的默认值。然而，有时您可能需要根据自身需求对 JSON 进行微调。例如，您可能希望更改某些名称以匹配日志摄入系统的预期。此外，您还可能希望过滤掉某些成员，因为您认为它们没有用处。

items.source: The following properties allow you to change the way that structured logging JSON is written:
items.translation: 以下属性允许您更改结构化日志 JSON 的写入方式：

items.source: Filters specific paths from the JSON
items.translation: 过滤 JSON 中的特定路径

items.source: Renames a specific member in the JSON
items.translation: 重命名 JSON 中的特定成员

items.source: Adds additional members to the JSON
items.translation: 向 JSON 添加额外成员

items.source:
Complete stack traces are included in the JSON output whenever a message is logged with an exception.
This amount of information may be costly to process by your log ingestion system, so you may want to tune the way that stack traces are printed.
items.translation: 完整的堆栈跟踪会包含在带有异常的日志消息的 JSON 输出中。由于此类信息量可能会给您的日志摄入系统带来处理成本，您可能需要调整打印堆栈跟踪的方式。

items.source: To do this, you can use one or more of the following properties:
items.translation: 为此，您可以使用以下一个或多个属性：

items.source: The maximum length that should be printed
items.translation: 应打印的最大长度

items.source: The maximum number of frames to print per stack trace (including common and suppressed frames)
items.translation: 每堆栈跟踪中要打印的最大帧数（包括公共帧和抑制帧）

items.source: If common frames should be included or removed
items.translation: 如果应包含或移除公共框架

items.source: If a hash of the stack trace should be included
items.translation: 如果应包含堆栈跟踪的哈希值

items.source: For example, the following will use root first stack traces, limit their length, and include hashes.
items.translation: 例如，以下命令将使用根堆栈跟踪、限制其长度并包含哈希值。

items.source: As you can see in the example, you can return any format, it doesn’t have to be JSON.
items.translation: 正如示例所示，您可以返回任何格式，不必是 JSON。

items.source: Since logging is initialized before the ApplicationContext is created, it is not possible to control logging from @PropertySources in Spring @Configuration files. The only way to change the logging system or disable it entirely is through System properties.
items.translation: 由于日志在创建 ApplicationContext 之前就已初始化，因此无法从 Spring @Configuration 文件中的 @PropertySources 控制日志。 更改日志系统或完全禁用它的唯一方法是通过系统属性。

items.source: For more advanced customizations, you can use the StructuredLoggingJsonMembersCustomizer interface. You can reference one or more implementations using the logging.structured.json.customizer property. You can also declare implementations by listing them in a META-INF/spring.factories file.
items.translation: 对于更高级的自定义，您可以使用 StructuredLoggingJsonMembersCustomizer 接口。 您可以通过 logging.structured.json.customizer 属性引用一个或多个实现。 您还可以通过在 META-INF/spring.factories 文件中列出它们来声明实现。

items.source: The source must be specified in kebab case (such as my.property-name). However, properties can be added to the Environment by using the relaxed rules.
items.translation: 必须使用连字符形式指定 source（例如 my.property-name）。 但是，可以使用宽松规则向 Environment 添加属性。

items.source: If you have a spring.application.name property but don’t want it logged you can set logging.include-application-name to false.
items.translation: 如果您有 spring.application.name` 属性但不希望记录它，可以将 `logging.include-application-name` 设置为 `false。

items.source: If you have a spring.application.group property but don’t want it logged you can set logging.include-application-group to false.
items.translation: 如果您有 spring.application.group` 属性但不希望记录它，可以将 `logging.include-application-group` 设置为 `false。

items.source: The above approach will only work for package level logging. Since relaxed binding always converts environment variables to lowercase, it is not possible to configure logging for an individual class in this way. If you need to configure logging for a class, you can use the SPRING_APPLICATION_JSON variable.
items.translation: 上述方法仅适用于包级别的日志记录。 由于松耦合绑定 始终将环境变量转换为小写，因此无法以这种方式为单个类配置日志记录。 如果需要为某个类配置日志记录，可以使用 SPRING_APPLICATION_JSON 变量。

items.source: When possible, we recommend that you use the -spring variants for your logging configuration (for example, logback-spring.xml rather than logback.xml). If you use standard configuration locations, Spring cannot completely control log initialization.
items.translation: 在可能的情况下，我们建议您使用 -spring 变体进行日志配置（例如，使用 logback-spring.xml 而不是 logback.xml）。 如果使用标准配置位置，Spring 无法完全控制日志初始化。

items.source: Because the standard logback.xml configuration file is loaded too early, you cannot use extensions in it. You need to either use logback-spring.xml or define a logging.config property.
items.translation: 由于标准的 logback.xml 配置文件加载过早，因此无法在其中使用扩展。 您需要使用 logback-spring.xml 或定义一个 logging.config 属性。

items.source: Because the standard log4j2.xml configuration file is loaded too early, you cannot use extensions in it. You need to either use log4j2-spring.xml or define a logging.config property.
items.translation: 由于标准 log4j2.xml 配置文件加载过早，因此无法在其中使用扩展。 您需要使用 log4j2-spring.xml 或定义一个 logging.config 属性。

items.source: Logback does not have a FATAL level. It is mapped to ERROR.
items.translation: Logback 没有 FATAL 级别。 它被映射到 ERROR。

items.source: You can also specify debug=true in your application.properties.
items.translation: 您也可以将 debug=true 指定在您的 application.properties 中。

items.source: logging.structured.ecs.service.name will default to spring.application.name if not specified.
items.translation: 如果未指定，logging.structured.ecs.service.name 将默认为 spring.application.name。

items.source: logging.structured.ecs.service.version will default to spring.application.version if not specified.
items.translation: 如果未指定，logging.structured.ecs.service.version 将默认为 spring.application.version。

items.source: logging.structured.gelf.host will default to spring.application.name if not specified.
items.translation: 如果未指定，logging.structured.gelf.host 将默认为 spring.application.name。

items.source: logging.structured.gelf.service.version will default to spring.application.version if not specified.
items.translation: 如果未指定，logging.structured.gelf.service.version 将默认为 spring.application.version。

items.source: The extensions supersede the Spring Boot support provided by Log4J. You should make sure not to include the org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-spring-boot module in your build.
items.translation: 扩展项取代了 Log4J 提供的 Spring Boot 支持。 您应确保在构建中不包含 org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-spring-boot 模块。

items.source: The Spring Environment is only considered when system properties and OS environment variables do not contain the value being loaded.
items.translation: 仅在系统属性和操作系统环境变量不包含要加载的值时，才会考虑 Spring Environment。

items.source: System properties that are loaded during early Log4j2 initialization cannot reference the Spring Environment. For example, the property Log4j2 uses to allow the default Log4j2 implementation to be chosen is used before the Spring Environment is available.
items.translation: 在 Log4j2 早期初始化期间加载的系统属性无法引用 Spring Environment。 例如，Log4j2 用于允许选择默认 Log4j2 实现的属性在 Spring Environment 可用之前就被使用了。

items.source: For more details about correlation IDs, please see this documentation.
items.translation: 有关关联 ID 的更多详细信息，请查看此文档。

items.source: Logging properties are independent of the actual logging infrastructure. As a result, specific configuration keys (such as logback.configurationFile for Logback) are not managed by spring Boot.
items.translation: 日志属性独立于实际的日志基础设施。 因此，特定的配置键（例如 Logback 的logback.configurationFile）不由 Spring Boot 管理。

items.source: The extensions cannot be used with Logback’s configuration scanning. If you attempt to do so, making changes to the configuration file results in an error similar to one of the following being logged:
items.translation: 扩展无法与 Logback 的配置扫描一起使用。 如果尝试这样做，修改配置文件会导致记录类似以下之一的错误：

items.source: The lookup key should be specified in kebab case (such as my.property-name).
items.translation: 查找键应使用连字符小写格式指定（例如 my.property-name）。

items.source: There are a lot of logging frameworks available for Java. Do not worry if the above list seems confusing. Generally, you do not need to change your logging dependencies and the Spring Boot defaults work just fine.
items.translation: Java 有许多可用的日志框架。 如果上面的列表看起来令人困惑，请不要担心。 通常，您无需更改日志依赖项，Spring Boot 的默认设置即可正常工作。

items.source: When you deploy your application to a servlet container or application server, logging performed with the Java Util Logging API is not routed into your application’s logs. This prevents logging performed by the container or other applications that have been deployed to it from appearing in your application’s logs.
items.translation: 当您将应用程序部署到 Servlet 容器或应用服务器时，使用 Java Util Logging API 执行的日志记录不会路由到您的应用程序的日志中。 这会导致由容器或其他已部署到该容器的应用程序执行的日志记录不出现在您的应用程序的日志中。

items.source: There are known classloading issues with Java Util Logging that cause problems when running from an 'executable jar'. We recommend that you avoid it when running from an 'executable jar' if at all possible.
items.translation: Java 实用程序日志 (Java Util Logging) 存在已知的类加载问题，导致从“可执行 jar"运行时出现问题。 我们建议您尽可能避免在从“可执行 jar"运行时使用它。
